notes.title: A Night In Kyosaka full game development
notes.notes:
Sorry to post sad news for people who enjoyed the demo, but our Kickstarter for this game failed to meet its goal, so we can't continue work on the full game release. This demo is the most you'll be able to play.  For the people who supported us, we thank you so much and it didn't go unnoticed. We had a lot of fun making this demo and a lot of fun things planned for the full game. We hope you could see the love in the demo.

This is also the last game Skyride Studios will make for a while because apparently, the games we want to make aren't popular enough to support the artists. Thank you for the fun years and for showing some ideas that we never thought we could. Have a good one.

-Skyride Studios

notes.title: Demo releases August 2nd!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40765436/e69f28cbdf86b7db872835658bd489c8a7015a0f.png[/img]

Hello! We are excited to announce our demo will release august 2nd for anyone interested in playing it. If you enjoy it, we have some ideas on how to get the full game made and will keep you updated on here as well as our social media platforms. We can't wait for you to explore the world of Kyosaka!

-Skyride Studios
